prompt: Water's over the road on my usual route. Can I just gun it?
response: No. Do not gun it, buddy. Turn around and find another way — I mean it. You can't see the road under that water, and half the time it's washed clean out from under. A foot of moving water will pick that truck up and float her off downstream, and more folks drown in a vehicle in a flood than anyplace else. I know it's your usual road. It ain't your road today. Turn around, don't drown.
